#### Name clusters
First I had run FindAllMarkers to find the markers per cluster, then I renamed the clusters according to the markers and then rerun the marker finding for each cell type

```{r find cell type markers of all cells}

Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.2"

table(seurat$orig.ident, seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.2)

cl_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/top_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top50_cl_markers, "Plots/top50_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/top_cl_markers.csv")

DimPlot(seurat, reduction="umap_css",  group.by="RNA_snn_res.0.2", cols = rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(12)), pt.size = 0.3) & NoAxes()
DimPlot(seurat, reduction="umap_css",  group.by="RNA_snn_res.0.2", cols = rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(12)), pt.size = 0.1, split.by = "condition") & NoAxes()

DotPlot(seurat, features = top2_cl_markers$gene) + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(seurat, features = c("AIF1", "CX3CR1", "SALL1", "CDH1")) + RotatedAxis()

table(seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.2)
table(seurat$condition)
table(seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.2, seurat$condition)

```

```{r name clusters}

DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.2"

seurat$celltype <- factor(setNames(c("Hindbrain neuron", # 0 PBX3, MEIS2 - https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-019-12054-3 ; (hindbrain??)
                                     "Immature choroid plexus 1", # 1 TRMT112, IGFBP2, RNMT
                                     "Forebrain neuron", # 2 NEUROD6, NFIB, NFIA, NEUROD2
                                     "Immature forebrain neuron", # 3 FOXP1, EBF1, SYT4, TAC1, DLX6, MEIS2, ROBO1
                                     "Progenitors", # 4 HES5, CENPF, TOP2A, UBE2C, HMGB2, SFRP1, VIM, NUSAP1, FABP7
                                     "Microglia", # 5 TPM2, TAGLN, COL1A1, CALD1, TPM3 high
                                     "Epithelia", # 6 KRT17, S100A8, KRT19, S100A6, ANXA1
                                     "", # 7
                                     "Forebrain interneuron", # 8 CRABP1, FSTL5, TRH, GNG8, CALB2, ATF5, AVP, EPCAM, EFNA5, EMX2, GPX2, S100A6
                                     "Fibroblast", # 9
                                     "Choroid plexus", # 10
                                     "Fibroblast" # 11 FN1, IGFBP7, IFITM3, S100B, COL1A2, VIM, OLFML2A, COL1A1, PMP22
                                     ), levels(seurat@active.ident))[seurat@active.ident])

ct_levels <- factor(c("BAM_1", "BAM_2",  "PAM_1", "PAM_2", "proliferating", "muscle-like"))
seurat$celltype <- factor(x = seurat$celltype, levels = ct_levels)

pdf("Plots/umap_by_celltype.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
DimPlot(seurat, reduction = "umap_css", group.by = "celltype",pt.size = 0.5, label=F, cols=rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(6))) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
    
png("Plots/umap_by_celltype.png", width = 2800, height = 1900, res = 400)
DimPlot(seurat, reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.4, label = T) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
```
